name: Λύκος
evidence: Rocky beach with small pier, 2-3 small hotels/tavernas on the sea; no source mentions sunbeds/umbrellas at Lykos itself (nearby Glyka Nera/Sfakia beaches do).

name: Παραλία Χαλέπα
evidence: No source found describing organization of the Chalepa beach itself.

name: Παραλίες Βάταλου
evidence: Described as a large, isolated, non-organized sandy beach ('μη οργανωμένη') west of Frangokastello.

name: Παχιά Άμμος
evidence: Main Paleochora beach, Blue Flag, organized almost along its whole length with umbrellas and sunbeds; cafes/restaurants along the shore.

name: Finikas
evidence: Finikas (Sfakia, west of Loutro) is partly organized with umbrellas, sunbeds and canoes; taverna right on the beach.

name: Κόρφος
evidence: Gavdos guidance: 'μην περιμένεις ξαπλώστρες, ομπρέλες και οργανωμένες παραλίες'; Korfos has tavernas/rooms next to it but no sunbed organization.

name: Σαρακίνικο
evidence: Sources state 'δεν υπάρχουν ομπρέλες – ξαπλώστρες'; it is the most 'organized' Gavdos beach only in the sense of tavernas, mini market and rooms nearby.

name: Φόδελε
evidence: Central-western section fully organized with umbrellas, loungers, showers, water sports, cafes and tavernas (eastern section unorganized).

name: Τρυπητή
evidence: Tripiti (Asterousia) 'is not organized at all'; shade only under tamarisks, seasonal taverna, informal camping.

name: Άγιος Γεώργιος
evidence: At the eastern cove (Lichnistis) of Agios Georgios near Agia Galini there are rooms, a small taverna and umbrellas; area otherwise quiet/semi-wild.

name: Καραβοστάσι
evidence: Karavostasi at Bali (33 km east of Rethymno) is an organized beach with sunbeds, umbrellas, water sports, plus cafe-bars and tavernas.

name: Παλίγκρεμνος
evidence: Paligremnos (east end of Plakias beach) is sandy and well organized next to hotels and tavernas; listed facilities include umbrellas, water sports, lifeguard, showers, Blue Flag.

name: Πολύριζος
evidence: Polyrizos (Rodakino) described as a quiet shallow sandy beach 'με ομπρέλες, ξαπλώστρες και ταβέρνες'; reviews note sunbeds in some spots, most of the beach free.

name: Σπήλιες
evidence: Spilies (Latzima, east of Rethymno) 'is organized with sunbeds, umbrellas and a canteen'.

name: Άγιος Παντελεήμονας
evidence: Agios Panteleimonas at Kalo Chorio/Istron is sandy and well organized with umbrellas, showers and water sports; called the most organized beach of the area.

name: Άμμος Ξερόκαμπου
evidence: Xerokambos area guides list umbrellas among facilities for the main beach, but no source clearly ties sunbeds to this specific sub-beach; area is remote and mostly undeveloped.

name: Βόλια
evidence: No source found describing organization of Volia specifically; Xerokambos beaches are generally undeveloped.

name: Βουρλιά
evidence: Only a low-quality map listing vaguely calls Vourlia (Xerokambos) 'fairly organized'; no explicit sunbed/umbrella evidence for this specific beach.

name: Διασκάρι
evidence: Diaskari (east of Makry Gialos) is partially organized: western section has a small number of umbrellas, sunbeds and a traditional taverna; rest pristine.

name: Λαγκάδα
evidence: Lagada (near Pefki/Makry Gialos) is a generally deserted fine-pebble beach with a nudist section; no sunbeds/umbrellas.

name: Μαριδάτη
evidence: Maridati (Palaikastro) 'παραμένει εντελώς ανοργάνωτη, χωρίς ομπρέλες ή ξαπλώστρες'; a few rooms and a taverna nearby.

name: Πλάκα
evidence: Plaka opposite Spinalonga (Elounda) is well organized: most of the beach has umbrellas and sunbeds, plus changing rooms, showers, restaurants/cafes/bars; Spinalonga boats depart here.

name: Πλάκα Ελούντας
evidence: Same Plaka Elounda beach: 'καλά οργανωμένη (ομπρέλες, ξαπλώστρες, θαλάσσια σπορ)', with restaurants, cafes and bars in the settlement.

name: Χιόνα Παλαίκαστρου
evidence: Conflicting: one guide says 'only a few sunbeds and umbrellas', another says it is not an organized beach (shade from tamarisks, three fish tavernas at the beach).

name: Palm Bay Beach
evidence: No sources found for a 'Palm Bay' beach in Lasithi (results only cover Vai and a Sissi hotel of that name).

name: Κομοτηνή Φανάρι Αρωγή
evidence: Arogi beach (continuation of Fanari, Rodopi) is a busy organized Blue Flag beach; along its 3.5 km there are beach bars fully equipped with sunbeds, loungers, umbrellas and tables.

name: Σκίδια
evidence: Skidia (south Thasos) is a deserted rocky cove 'δίχως οργάνωση'; a taverna sits on the small cape above it.

name: Κοίνυρα
evidence: Kinira beach 'is not organized' — no sunbeds for rent; explicitly recommended to those avoiding organized beaches (nearby Paradise beach is the organized one).

name: Χρυσή Ακτή
evidence: Chrysi Akti / Golden Coast (north Thasos) has sunbeds and umbrellas, a beach bar, water sports and disabled access; Blue Flag, largely fully organized.

name: Παραλία Γαλάνης Νέστου
evidence: Organization evidence found only for nearby Erasmio beach (beach bar with sunbeds), not for Galani Nestou itself.

name: Παραλία Σαλαώρας
evidence: Only a sea-access (Seatrac) listing found for Salaora, Amvrakikos; no source describes sunbeds/umbrellas or a beach bar.

name: Άη Γιαννάκης
evidence: Conflicting sources for Ai Giannakis (Parga side of Preveza): one calls it organized with water sports, another says there are no set umbrellas, only a canteen above the beach.

name: Κυανή Ακτή
evidence: Kyani Akti (3 km from Preveza town) is fully organized with the Kiani Akti beach bar; sunbeds and umbrellas free with a coffee/drink purchase; Blue Flag.

name: Παντοκράτορας
evidence: Sources describe a popular in-town swimming spot with small shops in the settlement, but none state sunbeds/umbrellas or a beach bar on the beach.

name: Παραλία Αμμουδιά
evidence: Ammoudia (Acheron mouth) is organized in a large part: sunbeds, umbrellas, beach volley, water sports, beach bar and tavernas.

name: Παραλία Λύχνος
evidence: Lichnos (4 km from Parga) is organized with sunbeds, umbrellas, beach bars, tavernas and extensive water sports; central part mostly covered by umbrellas.

name: Παραλία Καστροσυκιάς
evidence: Kastrosykia is 'πολύ καλά οργανωμένη' with sunbeds, umbrellas, water-sports facilities and several food/coffee spots; also has free sections.

name: Παραλία Ριζών
evidence: Conflicting: one Preveza source says a few free umbrellas/sunbeds exist, another says the beach is not organized with no umbrellas, sunbeds or beach bar.
